Use case: stylized-concept. THREE references: 1 the LOCKED final game sprite identity, colors, BIG head proportions, pixel style; 2 game-size motion strip with frame count and layout; 3 original 3D motion at the same moments for body/arm/weapon pose only. Create a clean pixel game animation sheet. Keep the reference1 costume, shading and proportions exactly in ALL frames: dark purple hood, stern white porcelain mask, both equal-level pink eyes, crimson high collar, green-gem brooch, ivory cape with2tan motifs, crimson lining, far gold mechanical arm, near tan arm/purple wristguard, purple slim pants and gold leg braces. Both straight complete guns visible every frame: gray/gold/ivory hand cannon Whisper in near hand and teal-wrapped gray/gold cane at far hip. For R combine them as a long gray/gold cannon with hanging crimson tassel.
Every sprite only41 game pixels high standing,13pixel BIG masked head. Each native pixel an8x8 solid aligned block at8x display; few solid shade regions, NO tiny detail, noisy texture, gradients, dithering, blur or antialiasing. Only final23palette colors: #0E0814 #22162F #262A3A #5E0A2C #5A2E10 #3A2052 #A01248 #5E2E7A #4A5470 #A0581A #2E9696 #A86450 #D42A62 #D8902C #74859E #A89C7C #E0A07E #FF6EB4 #D2CAB0 #FFD878 #BCCEDC #F2EEDC #F4F8FA. Pink only eyes. Head identical every frame, translates only, no back view or upside-down. Death can bow entire head with body. Gold far arm and tan near arm 2-3px thick, solid hands connect with guns. Cape in every frame.
Transparent alpha background, no lines/numbers/text/frame borders, no effects (bullet,flash,smoke,grenade afterthrow,flowers,petals,beams). Same cell layout as refs2/3, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Each cell96x80 nativepixels, 768x640 outputpixels. Feet lowest row67 within each cell. Pivot around(47,56) native. Character standing height41native; much of eachcell empty. Shot muzzle right horizontal at y>=48 (W>=46), NOT at head height. Continuous anatomical coherent action; frame timing described below.
ACTION: BASIC ATTACK, 6 frames (League's attack1: he raises Whisper and fires): 1 the idle stance, the near arm starting to lift Whisper; 2 the near arm brings Whisper up and forward; 3 THE SHOT (the bullet leaves here): the near arm straight out to the right at chest height, Whisper level and pointing right, its muzzle NO HIGHER than 8 squares above the standing point (the blue cross of the guide); 4 the recoil, Whisper kicked up a little; 5 he twirls Whisper up beside his mask, barrel up; 6 back to the idle stance. The gold fist stays on the cane-rifle at his hip in every frame. The bullet and the muzzle flash are effects - do not draw them.
EXACT layout 3columns by2rows, 6frames only, size2304x1280. Leave emptyunusedcells. Everyframe same character, no duplicate poses except return idle.
